attrs.description: One sample = one underlying spatially matched LIDC nodule; reader-level ratings are retained. Underlying nodules are formed using pylidc scan.cluster_annotations().
attrs.missing_value_policy: None, empty string, NaN, and source rating 0 are missing; stored as NaN. Zero is not treated as a valid LIDC rating.
attrs.slice_spacing_definition: pylidc Scan.slice_spacing (derived from adjacent slice positions)

pretrain_config.objective: masked 3D block reconstruction, no skip connections, masked-voxel weighted L1 + 3D gradient L1

adjudication.hypothesis: Internal-structure cardinality is specified incorrectly in the current implementation.
evidence: Authoritative LIDC schema uses internalStructure codes 1..4.
Current implementation assumptions report internal_structure K=5.
The discrepancy is testable directly from the H5 and model code.
adjudication.next_decisive_test: Audit the actual head dimension, target builder, and every loss/metric path before another training run.

adjudication.hypothesis: Patient-level split leakage explains the failure.
evidence: Patient overlap across split pairs = 0.
adjudication.next_decisive_test: If nonzero, stop model work and repair split. If zero, this hypothesis is weakened.

adjudication.hypothesis: Several attributes are dominated by marginal prevalence, making raw accuracy/MAE misleading.
evidence: subtlety: validation mean-target SD=1.078, median-baseline MAE=0.872
internal_structure: validation mean-target SD=0.170, median-baseline MAE=0.017
calcification: validation mean-target SD=0.778, median-baseline MAE=0.278
sphericity: validation mean-target SD=0.784, median-baseline MAE=0.662
margin: validation mean-target SD=1.080, median-baseline MAE=0.830
lobulation: validation mean-target SD=0.879, median-baseline MAE=0.608
spiculation: validation mean-target SD=0.873, median-baseline MAE=0.541
texture: validation mean-target SD=1.111, median-baseline MAE=0.636
adjudication.next_decisive_test: Compare the neural model against the training-derived baselines per attribute; do not use aggregate accuracy as the decision metric.

adjudication.hypothesis: Reader disagreement materially limits attainable performance.
evidence: Mean fraction of 2+ reader nodules with disagreement across attributes = 0.539
adjudication.next_decisive_test: Use reader-count-stratified stability and agreement to estimate an attainable ceiling before judging architecture.

adjudication.hypothesis: There is recoverable image signal in cheap CT statistics.
evidence: Best handcrafted Ridge validation Spearman = 0.115
adjudication.next_decisive_test: If this probe is useful while the CNN is not, prioritize sample-efficient representations rather than a larger CNN.

adjudication.hypothesis: The observed best-checkpoint collapse is only an early-stopping artifact.
evidence: The prior full run's last checkpoint recovered prediction variance but remained near-zero in Spearman.
Therefore variance recovery alone did not restore generalization.
adjudication.next_decisive_test: Do not respond to collapse with longer training alone.

adjudication.hypothesis: The existing distributional objective is proven to be the root cause.
evidence: Current diagnostics can establish target semantics and baselines, but cannot prove an objective is causal without a matched objective comparison.
A small-data failure can arise from representation, supervision, objective, or their interaction.
adjudication.next_decisive_test: Only compare objectives after target/cardinality/mapping integrity and signal probes are established.

adjudication.hypothesis: The pretrained encoder is the root cause.
evidence: Checkpoint metadata can be inspected here, but metadata alone cannot establish transfer quality.
A frozen embedding probe is required to distinguish representation quality from head/objective failure.
adjudication.next_decisive_test: Run a frozen-encoder linear/nonlinear probe using the same train/validation split and target construction.

adjudication.hypothesis: A wholesale architecture replacement is currently justified.
evidence: Multiple opinions independently recommend diagnostic isolation before architecture search.
The current evidence does not isolate the encoder as the bottleneck.
adjudication.next_decisive_test: Choose the next model only after the diagnostic report identifies the limiting component.

next_required_evidence: only then a matched objective comparison
